name: The Empty Crates
description: Irina is waiting for materials needed to keep the factory running. Pavel claims the truck is delayed by militia inspection, but the crates tell another story.
offerText: Ask Pavel Sokolov about the overdue factory supplies.

stages.description: Ask Pavel Sokolov about the factory supplies.
Tell Kovalenko the truck is awaiting militia inspection.
Inspect the factory truck crates at night or with Stealth 8.
Tell Kovalenko the crates are empty. Irina fears that reporting the missing crates could put her workers under suspicion.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Irina finds empty factory delivery crates; Pavel blames a routine militia inspection.
implementationNotes: At supplies-crates inspect the EXISTING factory truck at night or with Stealth 8; do not invent a new container.
Irina worries about workers; Dusan suspects military diversion.
